channelTitle: Two brothers, one harvest, and the kindest secret ever kept
hook: This is the story Grandma June tells when somebody says family is too much work.
storyParts: Two brothers farmed side by side. Each night, the older one carried a sack of wheat to his brother's barn, thinking - he has children to feed, he needs it more.
And each night, the younger one carried a sack to HIS brother's barn, thinking - he works alone, he needs it more. Both barns stayed full, and neither could explain it.
One midnight they met on the hill, sacks on their shoulders, and understood everything. On that spot, the story says, they built their village well.
moral: Grandma June says that's what family is - carrying your sack across the hill without being asked.
cta: Who carries a sack across the hill for you? Tag them or tell Grandma June in the comments
